map.伺服液压系统设计：由负载质量、行程与响应频率算峰值加速度（取正弦运动幅值 X=L: Servo-hydraulic system design: from load mass, stroke and response frequency compute peak acceleration (sine motion amplitude X=L/2), times mass gives load force; take 2/3 of supply pressure as load pressure to estimate required cylinder area and bore. Hydraulic natural frequency is set by oil bulk modulus, cylinder area, stroke and load mass; system bandwidth is about 1/3 of natural frequency, and response frequency should be below bandwidth for stability.
